note: Illustrative portfolio policy for a synthetic hedge-fund technology centre. Weights, thresholds and rates are assumptions for demonstration, not any firm's policy.

sourcing.rule: buy when the capability is commodity (differentiation <= 2) and data sensitivity <= 3; build when differentiation >= 4 or data sensitivity = 5; otherwise hybrid (buy the model, build the workflow and controls)

value.rate_note: illustrative blended rate used only to translate hours into money; hours are the primary measure
